name: Ses Sucreres
description: A small hotel in the old centre of Ferreries, in the house that was the village sweet shop: Ca Ses Sucreres, where the children of Ferreries bought their sweets. It has been a hotel since 2009 and has grown through a contemporary extension that doubles the original capacity and adds shared spaces, a garden and a pond. It carries the Menorca Biosphere Reserve mark.
